volume_proxy_description: For each factor, at each sampled timestamp, factor values are ranked cross-sectionally. Long basket = top 20%, short basket = bottom 20% (matching paper convention). Hourly quote_volume is joined for the selected symbols. Selected-basket median/p10 volume is used as the liquidity denominator for capacity estimation. Sampling: every 4h for performance. Universe-wide median ($424,999) used as fallback when basket data unavailable.
